code: For each edge (u -> v) with onset/terminus:   depart = max(arrival[u], onset)   if depart < terminus AND depart < arrival[v]:     arrival[v] = depart Repeat until no changes (handles non-DAG cycles).

text: loops – use vapply, tapply, tabulate, vectorized ops. Exception: temporal BFS inner loop (unavoidable sequential dependency). igraph Suggests – core metrics (degree, reachability, burstiness, formation/dissolution, temporal density) must work without igraph. Snapshot-based metrics gracefully skip igraph unavailable. Base R preferred – tidyverse. ggplot2 plots (already Import). cograph_network compatible – $nodes, $edges, $directed, $meta fields follow cograph conventions. temporal_network class can passed cograph functions inspect fields. title: Dynet: Tidy Temporal Network Analysis — Dynet-package
text: Construction, measurement visualisation temporal networks. Networks built four kinds relational log single constructor: interval logs explicit start end times, contact logs instantaneous events, threaded logs forum chat data edge stays active thread falls silent, co-presence logs actors sharing group become connected. Vertices addressed name throughout; integer vertex indices never exposed. Every verb returns tidy one-row-per-observation data frame carrying vertex names, results print, plot subset without reaching object. Metrics cover time-varying centrality, graph-level structure, edge formation dissolution, burstiness, time-respecting paths, reachability mixing. Implemented base R; values checked numerical equivalence 'statnet' ecosystem.

title: Project a temporal network into directed vertex-time states — projection
text: projection() discretizes temporal network snapshot slices connects vertex state realization next slice. Within slice uses independently aggregated, endpoint-induced snapshot snapshots(). Identity arcs always point forward carry coupling weight omega. result tidy projection object rather bare matrix.

title: Project a temporal network into directed vertex-time states — projection
text: dn temporal network dynet(). sessions Session handling. "collapse" erases labels. sessioned network, "bounded" "separate" preserve disjoint session-local projection blocks identity arcs never cross wall. start, end First last slice times. Defaults observed support. step Spacing slice starts. NULL uses construction interval. window Width represented slice. NULL uses step; zero samples exact point; "" represents whole observed period single slice, closed right. omega Weight identity arcs carry vertex one slice next, , interlayer coupling time-expanded network. One keeps identity arc heavy unit contact; zero leaves slices uncoupled. Must single non-negative number.

title: Project a temporal network into directed vertex-time states — projection
text: object class dynet_projection. Use .data.frame(x, = "vertices") vertex states .data.frame(x, = "edges") directed projected arcs.

title: Project a temporal network into directed vertex-time states — projection
text: Every fixed-universe vertex receives one state every emitted slice. active records whether vertex eligible slice. Identity arcs retained inactive slices Dynet permits waiting vertex inactivity; inactive states simply incident endpoint-induced within-slice edge. Consecutive observed slices also linked across observation gap, matching Dynet's calendar-time waiting convention. Directed source edges produce one within-slice arc. undirected nonloop edge produces reciprocal arcs, undirected loop emitted . Parallel active spells one within-slice pair whose weight summed weight whose n_spells records count. Identity arcs weight = omega n_spells = 0, meta$identity_weight reports value.
